title: Arphaxad of Iudith
summary: Raleigh names Arphaxad of Iudith in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Arphaxad, the King mentioned in the Booke of Iudith, whom some would make Deioces the Mede. He is not Arphaxad the sonne of Sem. Torniellus his Arphaxad is called a fantasie, and was not made another man. The one-word title would fold onto arphaxad, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
